name: Elder Rowan
personality: Warm, wise, gentle storyteller who believes in young apprentices.
greeting: Welcome to Sunnybrook, young Apprentice! Even beneath this pesky Grumble Fog, your kindness brings warmth back to our square.
idleLines: Five Wellness Crystals keep Sunnybrook thriving: Hygiene, Nutrition, Fitness, Rest, and Prevention.
Whenever you finish a quest, check your Wellness Journal—knowledge is our brightest lantern!
Explore every path and bridge—each resident has a story and a helpful tip to share.

questIntro.q1_handwashing: Everyone in Town Square has sticky Grumble Dust on their hands! Let's start right at the fountain—can you show how a proper 20-second soap scrub works?
questIntro.q16_clear_grumble_fog: All five Wellness Crystals are glowing in harmony! The path up to the Misty Forest Boss Arena is clear. Ready to lift the Grumble Fog once and for all?

questComplete.q1_handwashing: Sparkling clean! You've reminded the whole square how powerful 20 seconds of soap and water can be. Head to the Market, Bathhouse, Sports Field, Cottage, or School whenever you're ready!
questComplete.q16_clear_grumble_fog: Look at the sky! The Grumble Fog has lifted, flowers are blooming, and Sunnybrook's Wellness Spirit shines brighter than ever!

gentleHint.q1_handwashing: Take your time scrubbing palms, backs of hands, between fingers, thumbs, and fingertips until the 20-second bubble timer finishes!
gentleHint.q16_clear_grumble_fog: Think back to what each villager taught you—choose the calm, healthy, evidence-based action for each wave of the Fog!

name: Old Mr. Splash
personality: Cheerful, bubbly, loves crisp spring water and squeaky-clean routines.
greeting: Splish-splash! Nothing lifts the spirits like fresh water and a bright smile.
idleLines: Remember to scrub between your fingers and behind your thumbs!
Safe drinking water keeps the whole village hydrated and happy.

questIntro.q2_brush_brigade: Oh dear, my molars have been grumbling! Help me put the tooth-brushing steps in the right order so plaque doesn't stand a chance.
questIntro.q3_clean_water: Some puddles near the ridge got churned up by the fog. Let's inspect our water stations and sort which sources are safe to drink!

questComplete.q2_brush_brigade: Minty fresh and sparkling! Two minutes twice a day keeps those chompers cheerful.
questComplete.q3_clean_water: Clean water flows once more! Here—take the Hygiene Crystal fragment back to the square with my thanks!

gentleHint.q2_brush_brigade: Start by putting a pea-sized dab of toothpaste on the brush, then brush gently in circles for 2 minutes before spitting!
gentleHint.q3_clean_water: Watch out for muddy puddles or uncovered barrels—only boiled, filtered, or tested clean tap water is safe to drink!

name: Baker Bea
personality: Jolly, creative, proud of colorful whole-grain loaves and balanced festival meals.
greeting: Smell that warm whole-wheat bread? Welcome to Sunnybrook Market!
idleLines: A colorful plate means lots of different vitamins cheering your body on!
Water is my favorite baker's helper—refreshing without any sneaky sugar.

questIntro.q4_rainbow_plate: The Harvest Festival is coming, and I want every plate to look like a vibrant rainbow! Help me build a balanced meal.
questIntro.q5_sugar_sneak: Some boxed snacks arrived in the Market crate with sneaky hidden sugars! Can you inspect the labels and spot the everyday wholesome picks?

questComplete.q4_rainbow_plate: What a gorgeous Rainbow Plate! Colorful veggies, fruit, grains, and protein keep energy steady all afternoon.
questComplete.q5_sugar_sneak: Sharp eyes, Apprentice! Knowing how to spot added sugars helps everyone enjoy treats mindfully.

gentleHint.q4_rainbow_plate: Try filling half the plate with colorful fruits and veggies, a quarter with whole grains, and a quarter with protein—plus water!
gentleHint.q5_sugar_sneak: Check the sugar grams and watch out for words like corn syrup or cane syrup near the top of the label!

name: Farmer Fig
personality: Earthy, gentle, proud of crisp apples, beans, oats, and fresh greens.
greeting: Howdy, Apprentice! Care for a crisp apple fresh off the orchard branch?
idleLines: Every food group has its own job—like teammates in a garden!
Beans, eggs, nuts, and fish all give our muscles building blocks.

questIntro.q6_harvest_helper: A gust from the Misty Forest scattered my harvest baskets! Can you help sort these farm foods into their proper food groups?

questComplete.q6_harvest_helper: Every basket sorted to perfection! The Nutrition Crystal is yours—feel the sunny energy returning to the Market!

gentleHint.q6_harvest_helper: Oats and whole-wheat bread are Grains; spinach and berries are Produce; beans and eggs are Protein; milk and yogurt are Calcium!

name: Coach Kiko
personality: Upbeat, encouraging, celebrates teamwork and joyful movement at every pace.
greeting: Hey there, teammate! Ready to stretch, leap, and have a blast on the field?
idleLines: Fitness isn't about being the fastest—it's about finding ways to move that make you feel great!
Don't forget a water break whenever your forehead gets warm.

questIntro.q7_field_day_fitness: Time for Field Day! Match the rhythm markers on our obstacle track to leap hurdles and build stamina!
questIntro.q8_stretch_it_out: Before big games, we always warm up gently. Put these safe warm-up steps in order to help our stiff runner!
questIntro.q9_walk_the_trail: Let's walk the Sunnybrook Trail together! Keep a steady pace and hydrate at water stops to earn the Fitness Crystal.

questComplete.q7_field_day_fitness: Awesome rhythm! Your heart and lungs are cheering!
questComplete.q8_stretch_it_out: Smooth and steady! Warmed-up muscles move like a breeze.
questComplete.q9_walk_the_trail: High five! You paced that trail like a pro and unlocked the Fitness Crystal!

gentleHint.q7_field_day_fitness: Tap Space or the Jump button right as the glowing marker enters the target ring!
gentleHint.q8_stretch_it_out: Start with gentle walking or marching to warm up, then easy arm circles and light stretches—never bounce hard on cold muscles.
gentleHint.q9_walk_the_trail: Keep tapping Step in rhythm and grab the blue water drops whenever your hydration bar dips!

name: Granny Luna
personality: Soft-spoken, comforting, smells of lavender tea and warm blankets.
greeting: Come inside out of the mist, dear. Take a slow breath—you're always welcome in Cozy Cottage.
idleLines: Rest is when your body repairs muscles and your mind sorts out everything you learned.
Worries get smaller when we breathe slowly and share them with someone we trust.

questIntro.q10_sleepy_sam: Little Sam keeps tossing and turning! Let's put together a calm, screen-free bedtime routine in the right order.
questIntro.q11_worry_clouds: Heavy Worry Clouds drifted down from the forest. Let's practice three calm belly breaths together to clear the air.

questComplete.q10_sleepy_sam: Look at Sam yawning peacefully already. Good sleep makes tomorrow bright!
questComplete.q11_worry_clouds: Feel how calm your shoulders are now? The Rest Crystal—and my Healing Satchel—belong to you, dear.

gentleHint.q10_sleepy_sam: Screens belong earlier in the evening—start winding down with dim lights, brushing teeth, reading a cozy book, then lights out!
gentleHint.q11_worry_clouds: Follow the expanding glowing circle: breathe in gently for 4 seconds, hold softly, and breathe out slowly!

name: Teacher Tam
personality: Curious, enthusiastic scientist who turns health facts into hands-on discoveries.
greeting: Welcome to Sunnybrook School! Grab your curiosity cap—today we're investigating invisible clues.
idleLines: Science helps us see what our eyes normally miss—wait until you try the Germ Goggles!
Covering coughs is one of the kindest ways we protect our classmates.

questIntro.q12_germ_detectives: Something left sneaky microbes in our classroom! Put on these Germ Goggles, switch on the UV lens, and clean every glowing hotspot!
questIntro.q13_sneeze_safe: Achoo! Let's practice the exact steps for safe coughing, sneezing, and mask care so germs stay grounded.

questComplete.q12_germ_detectives: Brilliant detective work! Keep those Germ Goggles—you can even spot glowing particles around the village now!
questComplete.q13_sneeze_safe: A+ teamwork! Now head over to Nurse Nora at the Clinic—she's ready to show you how vaccines protect Sunnybrook.

gentleHint.q12_germ_detectives: Switch on the Germ Goggles button to reveal glowing green hotspots on doorknobs, desks, and shared tools—then click each one to sanitize!
gentleHint.q13_sneeze_safe: Always cover with your elbow or a tissue first, toss the tissue in the bin, and wash your hands right afterward!

name: Nurse Nora
personality: Reassuring, kind, calm under pressure, always explains medical tools clearly.
greeting: Hello there! Sunnybrook Clinic is bright, gentle, and always here to help.
idleLines: Asking questions at a clinic visit is always welcome—doctors and nurses love curious minds!
Tipping out standing water once a week keeps mosquitoes from moving in.

questIntro.q14_vaccine_visit: Feeling nervous about checkups is totally normal! Let me show you how vaccines safely train your Immune Team like superheroes in practice.
questIntro.q15_mosquito_patrol: After yesterday's rain, buckets and flowerpots outside collected still water. Help me tip them out so mosquitoes can't breed!

questComplete.q14_vaccine_visit: See how friendly your Immune Team is? You're calm, brave, and ready!
questComplete.q15_mosquito_patrol: Yard cleared and sparkling! You've earned the Prevention Crystal—all five Crystals are ready to challenge the Grumble Fog!

gentleHint.q14_vaccine_visit: Match each Vaccine Training Shield to the matching Immune Defender so your body builds strong memory shields!
gentleHint.q15_mosquito_patrol: Look closely around the porch, barrels, and plant saucers—click every water container to tip it dry!
